Our Vision

Leading people into a growing relationship with Jesus Christ.

Our vision is to build a church community that is actively involved in leading the lost into a lifechanging relationship with Jesus Christ and involving them in a growing community of Christians who are corporately and individually worshipping God. We seek to build relationships through SHARING, COMMUNICATING, and CARING. We believe it is the only CHRIST-like way to truly Fellowship with one another.

It is our prayer and purpose to help people grow closer to Jesus Christ. If you are looking for a church home, or have questions about who Jesus Christ is, we want to serve you in any way we can.

Chesaw Community Bible Church is a place where people from all walks of life come together to worship, learn, and grow. Our church is committed to making a positive impact in the community and beyond.

At Chesaw Community Bible Church, we pursue God through worship, ministry, & giving. We strive to connect to one another, through Jesus Christ & what He has done for each & every one of us. At the heart of everything we do is the understanding that we must love God with all our heart, with all our soul, and with all our mind, and to treat our neighbors as we wish to be treated ourselves.
